scenes.narration: Most companies keep a few cents per dollar. How does Microsoft keep about 47?
In fiscal 2026, its revenue was 331.8 billion dollars, with 155.2 billion of operating income.
That is an operating margin of about 47 percent.
Its cloud business leads, followed by Office and business software, and then Windows and gaming.
Azure passed 100 billion dollars in a year for the first time, and Copilot has over 30 million paid seats.
